admission.justification: At least one proof names this invariant's exact behavior at the candidate.

applicability: Ordinary closeout and direct-landing commit-object publication through the shared publish_tree_commit primitive.
conditions: The route is the shared commit-tree primitive.
exclusions: Prepared code commits: --no-verify skips pre-commit and commit-msg, but prepare-commit-msg and post-commit still run.
Prepared memory commits retain ordinary Git commit hooks.
reference-transaction is a ref hook and still runs for this primitive.
statement: Ordinary closeout and direct-landing publication through publish_tree_commit runs no Git commit hooks, including the direct-landing memory commit; prepared closeouts retain their separate hook policies.
